blocks.rationale: Creates a corrected full airline calculator while changing the failed reader pattern: the route-and-cabin base schedule is read as four scalar fields inside one coupled fee record instead of an unresolved checked_base_fees array. It also keeps carry-on allocation, bag ordering, and excess-fee combination in deterministic code.

blocks.rationale: Adds a focused MAUD classifier that reads whether an express pandemic-response exception applies to the covenant currently asked about. This prevents a COVID carve-out in the affirmative ordinary-course clause from being incorrectly transferred to a distinct negative interim covenant.

inputs.name: express_pandemic_carveout_applies_to_current_covenant
inputs.question: Does the text governing the covenant currently identified by the question expressly make a COVID-19, pandemic-measure, or commercially reasonable pandemic-deviation exception applicable to that covenant?

skill.intent: Determine whether the current ordinary-course or negative interim covenant expressly includes a carve-out for pandemic responses.

outputs.description: The native MAUD label Yes or No.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: express_pandemic_carveout_applies_to_current_covenant
fields.question: Is the current covenant itself, or a definition expressly applicable to it, subject to a COVID-19 or pandemic-response carve-out?

reads.question: Determine whether an express pandemic-response exception applies to the particular covenant identified by the current question, without transferring an exception from a different affirmative or negative covenant.
